title: Structured Output and Tool/Function Calling
description: Let a model call your Python functions instead of only returning text.
learningOutcomes: Define tools/functions a model can call
Route a model's tool call to real Python code safely

lessons.title: Defining Callable Tools
lessons.description: Describe a Python function so a model can call it correctly.
learningObjectives: Map a tool call to a real function

lessons.title: The Tool-calling Loop
lessons.description: Send results back to the model and let it decide the next step.
learningObjectives: Implement a call -> execute -> respond loop
Cap the number of tool-calling turns
Log every tool call for debugging

lessons.title: Safety Around Tool Execution
lessons.description: Never let a model-generated call run unchecked against real systems.

lessons.title: A Tool-using Assistant
lessons.description: Build a small assistant that answers questions by calling real functions.
learningObjectives: Combine several tools in one assistant
Return a final answer grounded in tool results

assignment.title: Assignment: A Safe Support Ops Assistant
assignment.description: Build a multi-tool assistant that resolves a refund request end to end, with a bounded loop, whitelisted safe dispatch, a confirmation gate on the destructive step, and graceful handling of a failing tool.
learningObjectives: Combine tool schema design, the bounded loop, and safe dispatch into one working system
Gate a destructive tool call behind explicit confirmation
Handle a failing tool without crashing the conversation or losing context
